name: Pothos
author: E. T. Carter
description: A pothos (Epipremnum aureum) trailing down the frame: many small heart-shaped leaves strung along several wandering vines, each leaf carrying a cool glowing midrib with herringbone veins, a warm glowing margin, and pale cream variegation. The vines hang and sway on a slow wind and the luminous leaves overlap into a lush curtain. Everything themes from the palette — foliage, veins, margin and variegation alike.

params.label: Leaf size
params.effect: Radius of the heart-shaped leaves in CSS px — small dense foliage to a few broad leaves.

params.label: Leaf density
params.effect: How full the curtain is, from a few sparse trailing vines to a packed wall of leaves.

params.label: Vein glow
params.effect: Brightness of the cool midrib and herringbone veins.

params.label: Margin glow
params.effect: Brightness of the warm glowing leaf margin (kept from the burning-leaf original).

params.label: Sway
params.effect: How much the vines and leaves sway on the wind; zero hangs them still.

params.label: Variegation
params.effect: Amount of pale cream variegation marbling on the leaves.
